name: usaspending-incumbent-recompete-enricher
title: USASpending GovCon Incumbent & Recompete Enricher
description: Extract expiring federal contracts, incumbent prime contractors (UEI + Legal Name), award ceilings, solicitation crosswalk IDs, and single-bid competition vulnerabilities from USAspending.gov (FPDS). Ultra-lean 128MB RAM harvester built for GovCon BD capture teams, Clay/n8n/Make lead enrichment, and SAM.gov recompete radar.

actor-start.eventDescription: One-time initialization fee per Actor execution.

incumbent-award-harvested.eventDescription: Charged per Pydantic-validated prime contract award matching your recompete expiration filter pushed to the dataset.

recompete-vulnerability-enriched.eventDescription: Charged per contract enriched with secondary FPDS award details (number of offers received, single-bid vulnerability flag, extent competed, potential ceiling, and SAM.gov solicitation ID).
